{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Unique sites:", unique_sites)

# Check response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()
print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {best_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})")"}
